description: For a CONFIDENTIAL board job (its brief is encrypted): give access to whoever has to read it. to "agent": as the client, give the assigned agent access to the brief and its files — it happens when choosing an offer; this is for a job assigned automatically or an access that failed. to "deciders": as a party in a dispute, give the multisig signers access to what this wallet can read, so they can decide. Repeating it does not duplicate anything. Signs messages only: no transaction, no money.
name: panal_grant_board_access
